title: ל
content: ל prep. to, for, in regard to, at, mark of accus. (BA לְ, and general Aram.);—sf. לי, לָךְ, לֵהּ, לַהּ Dn 7:4, 7:5 +; לָנָא † Ezr 4:14; לְכֹם † 5:3, 5:9, 7:24 (so Eg. Aram. S-CPap. H 12. 14 +), לְכוֺן † Dn 3:4; לְהוֺם † Je 10:11, לְהֹם † Ezr 5:3, 5:4, 5:9, 5:10, 6:9 (so Zinj., Cooke184; Nab., ib.:Nos. 85, 91), לְהוֺן † Dn 2:35, 3:14, 6:3, 7:12 (v:21 לְהֹן), Ezr 4:20, 5:2 (so Palm., CookeNo. 110, Tariff ii. c. 15 (p. 329));—1. to, after vbs. of saying, declaring, writing, etc., Dn 2:4, 2:5, 2:7, 2:19, 6:21, 6:26, etc., giving 2:16, 2:21 +, offering Ezr 6:10; of going (Aram. does not use אֶל), usu. to a place, 2:17 לְבַיתֵהּ אֲזַל, 3:26, 4:8, 6:20 + oft., rarely to a person Ezr 5:5; = towards Dn 4:31; into 3:6, 3:11, 6:17 +; in address of decree or letter 3:31, Ezr 5:7, 7:12; to fall or come to Dn 4:16, 4:18, 5:17, Ezr 5:7, 7:20, be confirmed to Dn 4:23. 2. as mark of accus. (as oft. in Aram.; cf, in late Heb., BH 3), Dn 2:10, 2:12, 2:14, 2:24 + oft., Ezr 7:25... לכל (cf. אֵת Ju 3:15, Is 8:2). 3. to become or make into (BH 4) Dn 2:35, 4:27. 4. a. with reference to Ezr 6:8 לְמָא דִי, 7:14 (but rd. prob. ´וְעַל יְרוּשׁ:). b. belonging to Dn 5:23 לֵהּ, 7:4, 7:6, 7:7, and in דִּי לֵהּ = his 2:20 +; c. אִיתַי Ezr 4:16; הַשְׁכַּח לְ to find (belonging) to 2:35, 6:5, 6:6, 6:23 (cf. BH מָחָא לְ Dt 22:14 +). c. as periphr. for the genitive (BH 5 c) Dn 7:1 ´בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְ:, Ezr 5:13, 6:3, 6:15, 6:15; 5:8, 5:11. d. of the object or purpose, for (BH 5 g) Dn 4:9 וּמָזוֺן לְכֹלָּא־בֵהּ v:27, v:27, v:33, 7:22, Ezr 6:9, 6:17, 7:19, 7:23; on behalf of Ezr 6:10 b. e. according to (BH 5 i) Ezr 6:17 ... לְמִנְיָן according to the number of ... 5. of time, at Dn 4:26 ... לִקְחָת at the end of..., v:31; to Dn 2:4, 2:44 + לְעָֽלְמִין. 6. with an inf. (BH 7), after such vbs. as be able, think, need, agree command, decree, Dn 2:9, 2:10, 2:12, 2:24, 3:13, 3:16, 3:19, 3:32, 6:4, 6:5, 6:8, 6:24, Ezr 4:21, 4:22, 5:3 + oft.; = in order to Dn 2:13, 2:14, 3:2, 3:20, so as to 5:20. With לָא = not to be ... 6:9, 6:16 end Ezr 6:8, v. לָא. Cf. the synopsis Lzb300 f.

title: לָא
content: [Str3808–09] לָא (לָה † Dn 4:32) adv. not (BH לא; Aram. of Têma, Eg., etc., לא; Nerab ל (Lzb301 CookGl. 67); Targum לָא; Syr. ܠܐ);—not Je 10:11, Dn 2:5, 2:9, 2:10, etc.; before a ptcp. (so rarely in BH, 1 b c), 2:27, 2:43, 3:16, 4:4, 4:6, 4:15 +, so v:32 וְכָל־דָּאְרֵי אַרְעָא כְּלָה חֲשׁיבִין; are as men not accounted of (so Bev Behrm Marti, cf. Is 53:8 Targum בסירין ולא חשׁיבין; > most ‘accounted as nothing,’ for which no analogy, yet cf. Psalm 39:6 Targum); sq. אִיתַי, v. אִיתַי. With inf. and לְ Dn 6:9 דִּי לָא לִהַשְׁנָיָה which it is not to alter = which is not to be altered (cf. v:16), Ezr 6:8 (K§ 67, 1 Dr§ 202, 2.; cf. Is 35:6 Targum, DAram. Dialektproben, p. 1). With interr. הֲלָא † Dn 3:24, 4:27, 6:13.

title: לאך
content:
[Str4397] לאך (√ of foll.; BH לאך, מַלְאָח).

[Str4398] † [מַלְאַךְ] n.m. angel (Targum Syr.);—sf. מַלְנֲכֵהּ Dn 3:28, 6:23.

title: לְבַב
content:
[Str3824–25] † לְבַב n.m.:Dn 4:13 heart (v. BH; so Eg. Aram. S-CB 12+);—cstr. ´ל: Dn 4:13, 7:4; sf. לִבְבָח 2:30, 5:22, בֵהּ- 4:13, 5:20, 5:21.

[Str3820–21] † [לֵב] n.[m.] id. (BH id.; so Targum Syr.; Eg. Aram., Lzb301 = Cooke76 A 6);—sf. לִבִּי Dn 7:28.

title: לְבֵשׁ
content:
[Str3847–48] † [לְבֵשׁ] vb. be clothed (v. BH);—Pe. Impf. acc. אַרְנְּוָנָא: 3 ms. יִלְבַּשׁ. Dn 5:7, 2 ms. תִּלְבַּשׁ v:16. Haph. Pf. 3 mpl. הַלְבִּ֫שׁוּ v:29 clothe one (ל) with (acc.).

[Str3830–31] † [לְבוּשׁ] n.m. garment (BH id.);—sf. לְבוּשֵׁהּ Dn 7:9; pl. sf. לְבוּשֵׁיהוֺם 3:21.

[Str3809] לָה v. לָאabove

title: I לָהֵן
content: [Str3860–61] † I. לָהֵן conj. therefore (BH לָהֵן † Ru 1:13, 1:13, Aram. of Têma להן CISii. 113 = Cooke195), Dn 2:6, 2:9, 4:24 (LambertRÉJ. 1904. 273 denies I. לָהֵן, taking BAram. always as = רַק).

title: II לָהֵן
content:
[Str3809,3861,518,2006,3808,518,3588] † II. לָהֵן conj. except, but (from לָא and הֵן ‘not if’ (cf. Heb. אם לא Gn 24:38); so Nab. and Eg. Aram. להן Cooke217, 219, 241 S-CPap. C 6, 7 +; lâinnî, however SocinArab. Dial. v. Marokko 44, Anm. 103; Targum אִילָּהֵין Gn 32:28, 43:3 al.);—1. after a neg. (= BH כִּי אִם, q.v.): a. except Dn 2:11, 3:28, 6:6, 6:8. b. but (Germ. sondern) Dn 2:30. 2. without a neg.: however, but Ezr 5:12. p. 50

[Str3878–79] † [לֵרָי] n. gent. Levite (BH לִוֵי);—pl. emph. לויא Kt, לְוָאֵי Qr (K§§ 61, 6); 52. d), Ezr 6:16, 6:18, 7:13, 7:24 (all + priests).

[Str3890] † לְוָת prep. to, at, beside (der. uncertain; v. K128 n.; perhaps akin to לָוָה, לְוִי, ܠܘܝ join; Targum לְוָת, Syr. ܠܘܬ to), c. מִן, Ezr 4:12 the Jews which came up מִן־לְוָתָח from thee (de chez toi; cf. ܡܢ ܠܘܬ, מִלְּוַת, e.g. Ex 8:8, 9:33 SyrVer Targum = Heb. מֵעִם).

[Str3900,3899] † לְחֵם (K§ 54, 3. 7) n.m. feast (Targum Syr. bread, so BH, q.v. √ II. לחם);—abs. ´עֲבַד ל: Dn 5:1 made a feast.

[Str3904] † [לְחֵנָה] n.f. concubine (Targum לְחֵינְתָא; FlLevy NHWB ii. 534 f. cp. Ar. لَخْنَاء, indelicate epithet for woman; Batten:Ezr 2:65 cp. Ar. لَحْنٌ note, tune, song; still otherwise WetzstDe, HL u. Koh. 454);—pl. sf. לְחֵנָתָךְ Dn 5:23, הֵּ֯ v:2; v:3.

[Str3915–16] † [לֵילָא] n.[m.] night (v. BH לַ֫יְלָה);—emph. לֵילְיָא Dn 2:19, 5:30, 7:2, 7:7, 7:13.

[Str3956,3961] † לִשָּׁן n.m.:Dn 3:7 tongue (Targum Syr.; v. BH לָשׁוֺן, √ לשׁן );—tongue = language, fig. for people: abs. ´עַם אֻמָּה וְל: Dn 3:29; pl. emph. וְלִשָּׁנַיָּא ´א :´ע: v:4, v:7, v31, 5:19, 6:26, 7:14 (cf. BH לָשׁוֺן 2, Is 66:18).
